scope: Broaden peer review to narrow Binary DXF parsers
Verify ACadSharp released read-side versus in-progress write-side ACIS/AcDs work
Translate only implementation-ready and independently bounded evidence into the parity plan

sources.name: ACadSharp v3.6.51 release notes
sources.observation: Release notes list ACIS payload reading for 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY, AcDs payload-area offset handling, and Prototype1b parsing. This is source/release evidence of reader work, not independent semantic qualification.

sources.name: ACadSharp v3.8.0 release notes
sources.observation: The reviewed release notes do not claim corresponding ACIS entity writer support.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue 1195
sources.observation: Documents prior omission of ACIS-backed entities on DXF writing; used to distinguish read capability from write/round-trip evidence.

sources.name: ACadSharp pull request 1240
sources.observation: ACIS entity writing remains an open proposal at review time; not counted as released implementation or qualification.

sources.name: xorgy/dxfscan
sources.observation: README describes a narrow one-pass Binary DXF parser for R13+, typed support for listed entity families, and an Unknown fallback. The repository page presented one commit and no release series at review time; no source audit, build, or run was performed.

sources.name: xorgy/dxfbin
sources.observation: README describes ASCII DXF to Binary DXF conversion, not independent Binary DXF parsing; do not count it as a second reader or independent vote.

implementation_readiness: Keep current PAR-07/S8 strict Binary-DXF local reopen as the gate.

If a specific parser question remains at that composed checkpoint, optionally inspect dxfscan at a revision pinned when the experiment is run; compare normalized semantic fields and typed/unknown/rejected dispositions, not byte identity or whole-document preservation.

If an AcDs/Prototype1b owner/offset join question remains, source-audit the released ACadSharp reader path at that composed checkpoint; keep parser discovery, payload extraction, entity attachment, and modeler semantics as separate evidence grades.

No third-party drawing fixture was downloaded or committed. Any future control is to be generated locally from scratch and kept temporary unless it independently qualifies under existing fixture policy.

validation.basis: Source/release/issue/PR page review only; no implementation correctness claim is made.
